item.title: DRC politician beaten to death after radio appearance about Ebola outbreak
item.description:
Local MP in North Kivu had urged residents to cooperate with health workers, days after authorities confirmed new cases near Butembo

  • Ebola outbreak: latest updates

A provincial politician in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been beaten to death by a crowd hours after he appeared on local radio urging people to cooperate with Ebola response teams, officials said.

The killing in North Kivu province is likely to further complicate efforts to contain the outbreak, the second in the region in less than two years. Continue reading...
